about: We are a retail-focused jewellery company engaged in the marketing and sale of a wide range of gold, diamond and Cubic Zirconia (CZ) jewellery through our own chain of retail showrooms since 2012. One of our Promoters, namely Ramchand Murlidhar Raimalani has been in the business of jewellery since 1999 vide proprietorship firm namely, M. K. Sons Jewellers.
